narrative: Material PL1__M22F7018 exhibits lumpy demand patterns with a CV of 1.30 and only 43.3% non-zero demand days, indicating a zero-inflated distribution. Lead-time is unstable (CV=2.31). The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 87 units and an order quantity of 269 units (compared to SAP baseline of 0 and 247 respectively). This achieves 95% service level while reducing annual costs by $3,029.62 (32.0%). The reorder point should be set at 127 units with a review period of approximately 3 days.
warnings: Intermittent/lumpy demand pattern - consider alternative forecasting methods

research_insights.selected_model: EOQ with Safety Stock (r,Q) continuous-review policy
research_insights.selection_rationale: Zero-inflated lumpy demand with unstable lead-time is best served by a continuous-review (r,Q) framework. A fixed order quantity derived from EOQ is triggered at the reorder point, with safety stock sized to the 95th percentile of demand-during-lead-time.
research_insights.boundary_risk: High demand variability (CV=1.30) and lead-time instability (CV=2.31) create uncertainty in buffer sizing. The robust safety stock of 109 units should be considered if stockout costs are high.
